input.subject: Comp for pricing your listing
input.bodyText:
Hi Ryan,

Pulled a great comp for pricing your Greenwich Village listing — 12 East 10th St just SOLD last week for $2.1M (2BR/2BA, 41 days on market, asked $2.195M).

Same block, similar layout and floor. This should help us land on a realistic number for yours before we go live.

Want to hop on a call tomorrow to talk strategy?

Best,
Daniel
